notes.title: TSoTC on Steam Deck
notes.content:
Hello,

[i]Tremendous Corporation[/i] would like to announce that [i]The Secret of Tremendous Corporation[/i] works tremendously well on [i]Steam Deck[/i], so now you can play [i]The Secret of Tremendous Corporation[/i] anywhere you want to play [i]The Secret of Tremendous Corporation[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9242770/0d77314beca0fb34224f680007ab92b96650471b.jpg[/img]

[i]Tremendous Corporation[/i] would also like to remind you to not let the fact that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/765480/Karambola/]Karambola[/url] works well on Steam Deck too lure you into playing it, as it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/380140/announcements/detail/3213893238058732456]infringes on a huge chunk of [i]Tremendous Corporation[/i]'s invaluable patent portfolio[/url].

Thanks you for your attention and have a nice day,
Tremendous Corporation

notes.title: Intellectual Property Warning
notes.content:
Dear gamers,

[i]Tremendous Corporation[/i], as a leading innovator in the game industry and publisher of such best-selling franchises as [i]Angry Cows[/i]™, [i]Your Farm[/i]® and the critically acclaimed [i]Vikings[/i]™® series, would like to issue an important warning about violation of our intellectual rights.

[previewyoutube=Rzs1Foi62z4;full][/previewyoutube]

We have been made aware about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/765480/Karambola/][b]Karambola[/b][/url], a short point-and-click adventure game with emotional fruit people overcoming the power of dark bird-thoughts. Unfortunately, the game has been published with no respect to [i]Tremendous Corporation[/i]’s broad portfolio of patents covering various innovative entertainment solutions, such as – among others – pointing, clicking, progressing through levels or having fun.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/765480/Karambola/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9242770/94f17b753b5dc3b52246596eafd3be6e8a26b799.png[/img]
[/url]

Please don’t download and play this infringing game that’s [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/765480/Karambola/]available now on Steam for free[/url], and under no circumstances leave a positive review about it should you find the game enjoyable (which we hope you won’t).

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/765480/Karambola/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9242770/589f94a6c03a7216d3b47017d8bfcb7dab882d51.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9242770/5c5d245c8b48a10c3f04950274c0e07e928e38a1.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9242770/8a276643c2b06022e1bbfc431a445005188b1958.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9242770/6161ccfb2f735c7f83a3137f778ed35f0e6a2646.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9242770/f4438b73cbbaa7c52ad331df7a3efedc6bb4265d.png[/img][/url]

Thank you for your cooperation and have a nice day,
Tremendous Corporation
